body: Credibility-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.42 (naive sector base rate 0.43) that: Sansera-Nichidai JV starts commercial production by 31-Mar-2027. Probability set only by the pre-stated rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/AUTO_COMPONENTS_peer_comparison.md section 5): p0 = 0.43 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'capacity', n=18); SAC -4.8 pts x weight 0.286 (N=8) -> p = 0.42. Evidence: Q2FY27 call (06-Nov-2026), opening remarks: 'commercial production at the Sansera-Nichidai JV is expected to commence towards the end of H2 FY 2027.' Sansera's ADS hangar slipped Jun-Jul -> Oct-2026 without explanation. Resolution: YES if the Q4 FY27 results release/presentation/call (or an NSE filing) states that the JV's commercial production began on or before 31-Mar-2027. 'Trial/sample production' only = NO. Source: Sansera Q4 FY27 earnings call transcript / presentation (NSE). Resolve by 2027-06-15; score with Brier vs the base rate, to test whether the credibility adjustment adds skill.

data.adjustment_applied: p0 = 0.43 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'capacity', n=18); SAC -4.8 pts x weight 0.286 (N=8) -> p = 0.42
data.adjustment_rule: p0 = leave-one-out pooled STRICT delivery rate (specificity-weighted share 'delivered'; partly=0) of the other 4 peers in the promise's category (all-category peer rate if <8 peer promises in that category). p = clip(p0 + N/(N+20) x SAC/100, 0.05, 0.95), N = company's scored promises, SAC in points (credit basis: delivered 1, partly 0.5; categories with n<5, or with <2 peers having data, pooled). P(base) = p0.
data.base_rate_reasoning: Naive forecaster = sector delivery rate for 'capacity' promises among the other auto-component peers (strict: delivered only, specificity-weighted; n=18). No company-specific information.
data.resolution_rule: YES if the Q4 FY27 results release/presentation/call (or an NSE filing) states that the JV's commercial production began on or before 31-Mar-2027. 'Trial/sample production' only = NO.
data.resolution_source: Sansera Q4 FY27 earnings call transcript / presentation (NSE)

title: Paper call: Sansera-Nichidai JV starts commercial production by 31-Mar-2027
